requirement:
Create `app/validators.py` with `parse_money(text: str) -> decimal.Decimal`. Accepts an optional leading `$`, optional thousands separators (commas) and an optional fractional part with at most 2 digits: `$1,234.50`, `1234.5`, `0.99`, `1,000`. Returns an exact `Decimal` quantized to 2 decimal places (`Decimal('1234.50')`). Reject with `ValueError`: negative amounts, more than 2 decimal places, misplaced commas (`1,23`, `12,34,567`, `,100`), an empty string, letters, a bare `$`, and amounts above 1,000,000,000.00. Also provide `format_money(amount: Decimal) -> str` returning `$1,234.50` style text (always 2 decimals, commas every three digits).
The project must also contain `app/main.py` defining a FastAPI `app` (entry point `app.main:app`) (no endpoints required) and `app/__init__.py`. Include unit tests (pytest).
acceptance_criteria: Valid amounts parse to exact two-decimal Decimals
Malformed, negative, over-precise and oversized amounts raise ValueError
